name: cache-timer
description: Shows how long until the main conversation's prompt cache expires, and warns before it does.

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: The starting TTL: 1h normally; 5m once the account is in usage overage. A model switch, or a cache read long after the last response, corrects it.

warnMinutes.title: Warn at (minutes left)
warnMinutes.description: A toast shows once when this many minutes are left.
